crossRefs.note: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then…

translations.web: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,
translations.bsb: You can sell us food to eat and water to drink in exchange for silver. Only let us pass through on foot,
translations.kjv: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
translations.asv: Thou shalt sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only let me pass through on my feet,
